content.text: 1. CHECK THAT STEERING WHEEL FREEPLAY IS CORRECT

content.description: Illustration showing steering wheel with arrows indicating freeplay movement and maximum play measurement of 30 mm

content.text: With the vehicle stopped and pointed straight ahead, rock the steering wheel gently back and forth with light finger pressure. Freeplay should not exceed the maximum limit.
2. CHECK STEERING LINKAGE AND GEAR HOUSING

items:
(a) Check the steering linkage for looseness or damage. Check that:

• Tie rod ends do not have excessive play.

• Boots are not damaged.

• Boot clamps are not loose.
(b) Check the gear housing for grease leakage or oozing.
